mapper.select: WITH ADMIN_BOARD_VIEW AS ( SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_ID , BOARD_TYPE_CODE , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_WRITE_DATE , BOARD_CONTENT , BOARD_DELETE_DATE , BOARD_POST_HIT , BOARD_STATUS FROM ADMIN_BOARD NATURAL JOIN USERS WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} ) SELECT ADMIN_BOARD_VIEW.* , BOARD_COMMENT_NO , ADMIN_COMMENT.USER_ID AS COMMENT_USER_ID , ADMIN_COMMENT.BOARD_NO AS COMMENT_BOARD_NO , BOARD_COMMENT_CONTENT , ADMIN_COMMENT.BOARD_WRITE_DATE AS COMMENT_BOARD_WRITE_DATE , ADMIN_COMMENT.BOARD_DELETE_DATE AS COMMENT_BOARD_DELETE_DATE , BOARD_COMMENT_STATUS , BOARD_COMMENT_CONTENT , BOARD_COMMENT_STATUS FROM ADMIN_BOARD_VIEW LEFT OUTER JOIN ADMIN_COMMENT ON (ADMIN_BOARD_VIEW.BOARD_NO = ADMIN_COMMENT.BOARD_NO)
SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_ID , BOARD_TYPE_CODE , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_CONTENT , BOARD_STATUS FROM ADMIN_BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE_CODE = #{boardTypeCode}
SELECT A.BOARD_NO , A.USER_ID , A.BOARD_TYPE_CODE , A.BOARD_TITLE , A.BOARD_CONTENT , A.BOARD_STATUS FROM ADMIN_BOARD A INNER JOIN USERS U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}
